# 1. Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(vegan)
library(ggforce)
library(plotrix)
library(patchwork)
library(sjPlot)
```

# 2. Load and Prepare Fish Data
```{r}
# Load analysis-ready fish dataset
fish_raw <- read_csv("../analysis_data/RLS_allfish_analysis_ready.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# Filter for reef fish only and report sites
fish_base <- fish_raw %>% 
  filter(list == "Reef_fish", report_site == "Yes") %>% 
  mutate(
    sector = if_else(sector == "Mornington", "Southern", sector),
    t_id = paste(site_code, year, transect_2, sep = "_")
  )

```

# 3.Diversity & Biomass Pipeline Function
This helper function computes richness, abundance, Shannon/Simpson diversity indices, and total biomass per transect ($T\_ID$), and merges them back with site metadata.
```{R}
compile_diversity_data <- function(data_subset) {
  
  # 1. Create wide species matrix for vegan indices
  fish_mat <- data_subset %>% 
    dplyr::select(t_id, Species_name, stand_abund_100m) %>% 
    group_by(t_id, Species_name) %>% 
    summarise(total = sum(stand_abund_100m), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = Species_name, values_from = total, values_fill = 0)
  
  spec_mat <- fish_mat %>% dplyr::select(-t_id)
  
  # 2. Compute diversity metrics
  diversity_results <- fish_mat %>% 
    mutate(
      richness = rowSums(spec_mat > 0),
      abundance = rowSums(spec_mat),
      shannon = diversity(spec_mat),
      simpson = diversity(spec_mat, index = "simpson")
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::select(t_id, richness, abundance, shannon, simpson)
  
  # 3. Compute total biomass per transect
  biomass_results <- data_subset %>% 
    group_by(t_id) %>% 
    summarise(total_biomass = sum(stand_biomass_g_100m, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 4. Merge metrics and attach unique site metadata
  site_info <- data_subset %>% 
    dplyr::select(site_code, reef_name, t_id, zone, situation, depth_morph, geomorph, region, sector) %>% 
    distinct(t_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  final_data <- diversity_results %>% 
    left_join(biomass_results, by = "t_id") %>% 
    left_join(site_info, by = "t_id") %>% 
    mutate(
      zone_sit = paste(zone, situation, sep = "_"),
      zone_sec = as.factor(paste(zone, sector, sep = "_"))
    )
  
  return(final_data)
}
```

# 4. Figure 17: Southern GOC (14 Sites)
```{r}
fish_southern <- fish_base %>% filter(sector == "Southern") %>% 
  mutate(situation = fct_relevel(situation, "Offshore", "Nearshore"))

div_southern <- compile_diversity_data(fish_southern)

# Colors for 14-site Southern GOC
col_14 <- c("#54C1CB", "#D0D1D1", "#BDDBDD")

# A) Density Plot
p_dens_17 <- ggplot(div_southern, aes(y = abundance, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sit)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "black", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, notch = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_14) +
  ylab(expression(Density~(n.100m^2))) +
  xlab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2500)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  facet_row(zone ~ situation, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

# B) Biomass Plot
p_bio_17 <- ggplot(div_southern, aes(y = total_biomass / 1000, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sit)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "black", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, notch = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_14) +
  ylab(expression(Biomass~(Kg.100m^2))) +
  xlab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 180)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  facet_row(zone ~ situation, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

# C) Richness Plot
p_rich_17 <- ggplot(div_southern, aes(y = richness, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sit)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "black", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, notch = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_14) +
  ylab(expression(Richness~(S.100m^2))) +
  xlab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 60)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  facet_row(zone ~ situation, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

# D) Shannon Diversity Plot
p_div_17 <- ggplot(div_southern, aes(y = shannon, x = reef_name, fill = zone_sit)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "black", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, notch = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_14) +
  ylab(expression(Diversity~(H.100m^2))) +
  xlab("") +
  labs(fill = "Zone/Situation") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 4)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  facet_row(zone ~ situation, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

# Combine vertically using patchwork
fig_17_combined <- (p_dens_17 / p_bio_17 / p_rich_17 / p_div_17) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

fig_17_combined

```

# 5. Figure 21: Broader Regional Subset (36 Sites)
```{R}
div_36 <- compile_diversity_data(fish_base) %>% 
  mutate(
    sector = fct_relevel(sector, "Outer-shoals", "Wessel", "Northwest", "Western", "Southern", "Northeast"),
    zone_sec = fct_relevel(zone_sec, "Open_Outer-shoals", "Open_Wessel", "Open_Northwest", "Open_Western", "Blue_Southern", "Open_Southern", "Open_Northeast")
  )

col_36 <- c("#EE8434", "#990033", "#94A89A", "#795C5F", "#54C1CB", "#D0D1D1", "#FADF7F")
```
